terms.definitionEn: A timed interpolation between supported property values after a change occurs.
terms.definitionAr: تغير تدريجي بين قيم خصائص مدعومة بعد ما يحصل تعديل.

terms.definitionEn: A setting that identifies which changing CSS properties should be interpolated.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد بيحدد خصائص CSS اللي تتغير تدريجيًا لما قيمتها تتبدل.

terms.definitionEn: A setting for the length of one interpolated property change.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد لمدة التغير التدريجي الواحد للخاصية.

terms.definitionEn: A property that applies geometric operations to an element's coordinate space.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتطبق عمليات هندسية على نظام إحداثيات العنصر.

terms.definitionEn: An at-rule that names and defines stages of a CSS animation sequence.
terms.definitionAr: قاعدة at-rule بتسمي وبتحدد مراحل تسلسل حركة في CSS.

terms.definitionEn: A setting that controls the rate of change across an interpolated property update.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد بيتحكم في سرعة التغير خلال تحديث تدريجي للخاصية.

terms.definitionEn: A setting for the waiting period before an interpolated property change begins.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد لمدة الانتظار قبل ما يبدأ التغير التدريجي للخاصية.

terms.definitionEn: A setting that points to a named sequence defined by an at-rule.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد بيشير لتسلسل مسمى ومتعرّف باستخدام at-rule.

terms.definitionEn: A setting for the time taken by one complete animation cycle.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد للوقت اللي بتاخده دورة حركة كاملة واحدة.

terms.definitionEn: A setting for how many times a named sequence runs.
terms.definitionAr: إعداد لعدد مرات تشغيل التسلسل الحركي المسمى.

terms.definitionEn: A media feature reflecting a user's operating-system preference for less nonessential movement.
terms.definitionAr: ميزة media بتعبر عن تفضيل نظام المستخدم لتقليل الحركة غير الضرورية.

terms.definitionEn: A mathematical timing curve that maps elapsed time to progress through an effect.
terms.definitionAr: منحنى توقيت رياضي بيربط الوقت المنقضي بمدى تقدم التأثير.

questions.question: What does this shorthand enable when opacity changes?
options: A timed interpolation of the opacity change
A repeating animation that starts on page load
A delay before the button enters layout
A transform that changes its position
questions.explanation: The shorthand configures an interpolated change for opacity over 200 milliseconds.
questions.explanationAr: الاختصار بيحدد تغير تدريجي لخاصية opacity خلال 200 millisecond.

questions.question: What does 300ms specify?
options: The pause before a change starts
The change duration
The number of cycles
The opacity value at the end
questions.explanation: transition-duration sets the time taken by each interpolated change.
questions.explanationAr: transition-duration بتحدد الوقت اللي بياخده التغير التدريجي.

questions.question: How does this transform affect layout flow?
options: It reserves 12px of additional margin
It changes the element's text alignment
It shifts the element visually
It moves every sibling by 12px
questions.explanation: A transform changes the painted coordinate space but does not reposition other boxes in normal flow.
questions.explanationAr: transform بتغير مكان الرسم بصريًا لكن مش بتحرك صناديق الإخوة في التدفق.

questions.question: What does this at-rule define?
options: A transition delay for all elements
A selector matching the pulse class
A media condition for animation support
Named animation stages
questions.explanation: @keyframes names a sequence and describes values at points in its progress.
questions.explanationAr: @keyframes بتسمي تسلسل وبتوصف القيم في مراحل تقدمه.

questions.question: What duration value is declared for the interpolated change?
questions.explanation: The declared duration is 250 milliseconds.
questions.explanationAr: المدة المحددة هي 250 millisecond.

questions.prompt: Interpolate opacity changes on this control.
questions.explanation: transition-property names the property whose changes should be interpolated.
questions.explanationAr: transition-property بتحدد اسم الخاصية اللي تغيرها يحصل تدريجيًا.

questions.prompt: Set each opacity change to take a quarter of a second.
questions.explanation: A duration can be written in milliseconds or seconds.
questions.explanationAr: المدة ينفع تتكتب بالـ millisecond أو بالثواني.

questions.question: How does ease-in change the pace of an effect?
options: It starts slowly and speeds up
It moves at a constant rate
It starts quickly and slows down
It waits forever before starting
questions.explanation: ease-in starts slowly and accelerates toward the end.
questions.explanationAr: ease-in بتبدأ ببطء وبعدها سرعتها بتزيد.

questions.question: When does the property change begin interpolating?
options: It starts immediately and lasts 200ms
After a 200ms wait
After 200 animation cycles
Only when the property is opacity
questions.explanation: transition-delay specifies a waiting period before the effect begins.
questions.explanationAr: transition-delay بتحدد فترة انتظار قبل ما التأثير يبدأ.

questions.question: Which duration wins for the chip?
options: 200ms
0s
400ms
1s
questions.explanation: With equal precedence and specificity, the later declaration wins.
questions.explanationAr: لما الأولوية والـ specificity يتساووا، القاعدة الأخيرة بتكسب.

questions.prompt: Move the tile 12 pixels along the horizontal axis.
questions.explanation: translateX() applies a horizontal translation by the supplied length.
questions.explanationAr: translateX() بتحرك العنصر أفقيًا بالطول المحدد.

questions.prompt: Refer to the named keyframe sequence called pulse.
questions.explanation: animation-name selects a sequence defined by @keyframes.
questions.explanationAr: animation-name بتختار تسلسل متعرف باستخدام @keyframes.

questions.question: How many times does this animation repeat?
options: Exactly once
Three times
Until the next style rule
Without a finite limit
questions.explanation: infinite requests unbounded repetitions until another event or style change stops the animation.
questions.explanationAr: infinite معناها تكرار مستمر من غير عدد نهائي.

questions.prompt: Set one animation cycle to last two seconds.
questions.explanation: animation-duration sets the time for one cycle.
questions.explanationAr: animation-duration بتحدد مدة دورة واحدة.

questions.question: What user setting does this condition respond to?
options: A preference for less nonessential movement
A preference for larger font sizes
A request for high contrast colors
A requirement to disable all transitions always
questions.explanation: The media feature detects a request to reduce motion effects.
questions.explanationAr: الميزة بتكتشف تفضيل المستخدم لتقليل تأثيرات الحركة.

questions.prompt: Use a constant rate for the opacity change.
questions.explanation: linear uses a constant progress rate over the effect's duration.
questions.explanationAr: linear بتستخدم سرعة تقدم ثابتة خلال مدة التأثير.

questions.question: What repeat count is specified?
options: infinite
questions.explanation: The declaration specifies three iterations.
questions.explanationAr: القاعدة بتحدد 3 مرات تكرار.

questions.question: What is a typical effect of this transform?
options: It adds 20 percent padding to every side
It changes the element's font weight
It increases the visual scale
It forces the element to become fixed-position
questions.explanation: scale() changes the element's visual transform, not its normal-flow dimensions.
questions.explanationAr: scale() بتغير الحجم البصري مش الأبعاد المحجوزة في التدفق.

questions.prompt: Define the named pulse animation stages.
questions.explanation: @keyframes introduces named animation stages.
questions.explanationAr: @keyframes بتبدأ تعريف مراحل الحركة المسماة.

questions.prompt: Disable decorative animation for users requesting reduced movement.
questions.explanation: The media feature can be used to tailor motion effects to user preferences.
questions.explanationAr: ميزة media دي بتسمح بتعديل الحركة حسب تفضيل المستخدم.

questions.question: How does a CSS transition differ from a keyframe animation?
keyPoints: A transition interpolates after a property value changes
A keyframe animation defines staged values
Animations can run without a triggering style change
Each has separate timing and iteration controls
questions.modelAnswer: A transition interpolates between property values when a change is triggered, while a keyframe animation defines a named sequence of stages. An animation can run according to its animation settings without waiting for a user-triggered property change.
questions.explanation: Transitions respond to changes; keyframe animations describe an explicit sequence.
questions.explanationAr: الـ transition بتستجيب لتغير قيمة، أما keyframes فبتوصف تسلسل مراحل صريح.

questions.question: What roles do duration, delay, and timing function play in motion effects?
keyPoints: Delay sets a wait before start
These settings can affect transitions and animations
questions.modelAnswer: Duration determines how long an effect runs, while delay sets how long it waits before beginning. The timing function shapes the rate of progress during that period, such as a constant or eased curve.
questions.explanation: These parameters control when and how an effect progresses.
questions.explanationAr: القيم دي بتحدد مدة التأثير ووقت بدايته وسرعة تقدمه.

questions.question: How should motion effects respond to a reduced-motion preference?
keyPoints: Detect the preference with a media feature
Avoid assuming every user has the same preference
questions.modelAnswer: Use the reduced-motion media feature to reduce or remove nonessential movement for users who request it. Keep important information and functionality available, and choose alternatives that do not depend on animation alone.
questions.explanation: The preference supports tailoring motion without removing essential content.
questions.explanationAr: مراعاة التفضيل بتقلل الحركة غير الضرورية من غير ما تخفي وظيفة أو معلومة مهمة.

questions.question: What information belongs in a keyframe animation definition and its use?
keyPoints: Animation properties control timing and repetition
questions.modelAnswer: A keyframe at-rule names a sequence and specifies property values at progress points such as from, to, or percentages. animation properties then choose that sequence and control its timing, delay, and repetition.
questions.explanation: The keyframe rule describes stages; animation properties control playback.
questions.explanationAr: قاعدة keyframes بتوصف المراحل، وخصائص animation بتتحكم في التشغيل.
